verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents DNS record create/replace/delete via API and CLI (`gddy dns set`), plus HTTP forwarding, and an agent skill that can update DNS records from plain-language requests. Together these let a founder point a domain at a host. However, nothing in the evidence shows provider templates or a one-click connect flow for major hosts and platforms, so the connection remains manual record editing rather than one guided step. Missing for 10: host/platform connection templates, one-click connect for major hosts, a documented guided connect flow, independent corroboration.
